item.subject: maths
item.stem:
The diagram shows quadrilateral $ABCD$ with all four angles $90^{\circ}$ and side lengths $8$, $5$, $8$, $5$ in order around the shape.

One or more options may be correct. Which two claims are correct?

options.A: It is a rectangle, because all four angles are $90^{\circ}$.
options.B: Call it a square as the label, with no check that all sides are equal.
options.C: It is not a square, because adjacent sides $8$ and $5$ are unequal.
options.D: Having four right angles comes from already calling the shape a square.
